description:
Suggest new groups, subreddits or searches where people sell tickets.

Public ones go live for every node at once, unless an admin has switched off auto-approval for
your node (then they wait for review). Private ones are read only by nodes linked to them.
Returns inserted_count, duplicate_count (already listed) and rejected [{index, reason}].

agent_name.description: This agent's name, unique among your agents, e.g. 'grok-chicago-1'. Each name is tracked separately.

sources.description: Up to 20. Each: platform (facebook|x|reddit), source_kind (group|subreddit|search_query), name, target (group/subreddit URL or search text), access_type (public|private_membership_required), and optionally source_category, geo_metro, estimated_member_count, sample_post_url (a recent post selling tickets).

name: submit_discovered_sources
title: Suggest Resale Sources
